candidate_dispositions.explanation: The label records therapy after the new symptom but omits that physical therapy was maintained during later follow-up. This continuing treatment is source-supported and material.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: She was maintained on physical therapy.

candidate_dispositions.explanation: The symptom details omit recurrent right-arm numbness and the reported pain-score range during follow-up. These are material symptom-course details.

added_findings.label_excerpt: Infusion of hypertonic saline through the Racz catheter for 30 minutes
added_findings.source_quote: on the next day, after infusion of hypertonic saline through the Racz catheter for 30 minutes, the catheter was removed with no side effects.
added_findings.explanation: The surgery details capture the infusion but omit that the catheter was removed the next day and that no side effects were reported. This procedure outcome is source-supported and material.

added_findings.label_excerpt: Tingling sensation from the right axilla to the fingertips, tenderness to the right trapezius muscle, new symptom of tingling sensation on right arm without pain after two months
added_findings.source_quote: Twenty-eight months after the Racz neuroplasty, the patient still had pain in the neck and right arm, and the intensity and duration of the pain was progressive.
added_findings.explanation: The label omits the persistent neck and right-arm pain and its progressive intensity and duration 28 months after neuroplasty, a material worsening in the symptom course.

initial.summary: Both candidate omissions are supported. The label also omits the catheter removal and no-side-effects outcome, later progressive pain, and two source-stated pain scores.
